activity.notes: Eulji Mundeok is securely attested as a Goguryeo commander in the 612 Goguryeo–Sui War, conducting reconnaissance and deception against the Sui army and playing the decisive role in the victory at the Salsu River. His exact court rank is debated in modern scholarship, so ATLAS records only the securely documented 612 military Activity rather than assigning a disputed senior civil office.

sources.title: Samguk Sagi: Eulji Mundeok investigates the Sui camp — National Institute of Korean History
sources.citation_text: The National Institute of Korean History's annotated Samguk Sagi records Eulji Mundeok acting under royal orders against the Sui army in 612 and identifies him as a Goguryeo military figure; annotations note disagreement over his precise court rank.

sources.title: Samguk Sagi: Eulji Mundeok wins a great victory at Salsu — National Institute of Korean History
sources.citation_text: The Samguk Sagi entry preserved by the National Institute of Korean History records Eulji Mundeok's 612 operations culminating in the Salsu victory and Sui withdrawal.
